title: Yorvyn Phase 13 — Hybrid AI Technology & Library Compatibility Matrix
target_architecture: Client-Side Edge Computing + Server-Side GPU Intelligence

primary_use_cases: Lightweight on-device garment attribute classification
Edge fabric pattern & texture recognition
Fast local silhouette embedding
matrix.rationale: Enables direct WebGPU-accelerated local inference without server round-trip latency. Provides seamless fallback to SIMD WASM when WebGPU is unavailable.

primary_use_cases: Zero-shot image classification
Multimodal text-image style search
Client-side CLIP image embeddings
matrix.rationale: High memory footprint (>60MB bundle and model shards). Evaluated for desktop and high-tier devices with lazy dynamic initialization, but deferred for low-end mobile to avoid memory exhaustion.

primary_use_cases: Client-side human pose landmark detection
On-body garment alignment & collar/shoulder anchor detection
User body framing and perspective calibration
matrix.rationale: Ultra-lightweight (<8MB wasm/model), rapid execution (~12ms per frame), perfectly suited for interactive avatar try-on framing without server video streams.

matrix.version_evaluated: Native OffscreenCanvas + Web Worker CV pipeline
primary_use_cases: EXIF orientation correction & aspect ratio normalization
Blur & defocus detection via Laplacian variance
Dominant palette extraction via color quantization
Intelligent multi-tier image downscaling & WebP compression (saving ~85% network bandwidth)
matrix.rationale: Native canvas and worker routines provide zero-bundle-overhead, ultra-fast (<25ms) image preprocessing off the React UI thread, preventing main-thread jank.

primary_use_cases: GPU-accelerated compute shaders for cloth vertex transformation
High-performance ONNX Runtime Web backend
Parallel texture processing & normal map generation
matrix.rationale: Delivers native GPU compute capabilities directly in modern browsers (Chrome 113+, Edge 113+, Safari 18+). Supported conditionally via DeviceCapabilityManager.

primary_use_cases: Ara human parametric mannequin generation
CPU fallback for ONNX Runtime Web and MediaPipe vision
matrix.rationale: Currently active in production powering Ara character generation. Provides guaranteed cross-browser compatibility across 100% of modern browsers.

primary_use_cases: Off-thread image resizing and compression
Off-thread blur detection and color quantization
Asynchronous model weight streaming and decompression
matrix.rationale: Guarantees 60fps UI responsiveness during intensive upload preprocessing. Isolates heavy array operations from React state renders.

primary_use_cases: Persistent local caching of verified ONNX model weights
Temporary caching of preprocessed garment textures
Device capability telemetry and user routing preferences
matrix.rationale: Eliminates repetitive network downloads for neural model weights (typically 5MB - 25MB). Implements strict quota caps and user-initiated purge capability.

primary_use_cases: Universal garment neural classification
Component detection & boundary regression
Continuous learning and neural fine-tuning
matrix.rationale: Core backbone of Yorvyn's neural garment intelligence services. Fully operational with MPS and CUDA hardware acceleration.

primary_use_cases: High-throughput server-side garment classification
BiRefNet foreground segmentation
Portable inference across containerized GPU clusters
matrix.rationale: Installed in backend environment and used for standardized inference benchmarks. Provides parity testing against onnxruntime-web.

primary_use_cases: Sub-10ms FP16/INT8 inference for production cloud workers
matrix.rationale: Requires target NVIDIA GPU hardware. Evaluated for production cloud deployments; developer environment on macOS utilizes Apple Silicon MPS.

primary_use_cases: Dynamic batching for multi-tenant high-volume inference
Concurrent model execution across GPU instances
matrix.rationale: Evaluated as an external inference cluster gateway. FastAPI remains the primary application API coordinator to enforce Supabase auth and entitlements.

primary_use_cases: Differentiable 3D representation learning
Tetrahedral mesh optimization for garment silhouettes
matrix.rationale: Specialized CUDA-only research tool. Evaluated for offline neural shape optimization pipelines, not required in interactive API loop.

primary_use_cases: Chamfer distance calculation against ground truth scans
Differentiable mesh rasterization and silhouette loss
matrix.rationale: Heavy build dependency. Evaluated and retained in reconstruction research sandbox for formal verification benchmarks.

primary_use_cases: Point cloud Poisson surface reconstruction
Mesh smoothing and laplacian filtering
matrix.rationale: Effective for point cloud processing. Evaluated for depth-sensor scans; parametric Trimesh pipeline handles single/multi-view CAD models cleanly.

primary_use_cases: Authoritative 3D mesh topology inspection (watertightness, manifoldness)
Degenerate face & disconnected component detection
Bounding box and center-of-mass validation prior to GLB export
matrix.rationale: Lightweight, robust, cross-platform, zero C++/CUDA compilation hurdles, and provides definitive geometric quality validation for GLB outputs.

primary_use_cases: GPU-accelerated cloth simulation constraint solving
High-density physical drapery generation
matrix.rationale: Evaluated against existing Three.js Position-Based Dynamics (PBD). Existing client-side PBD engine satisfies real-time interactive requirements without GPU server costs.

primary_use_cases: Offline synthetic garment render dataset generation
Automated regression rendering for reference cases
matrix.rationale: GPLv3 license restricts proprietary linking. Evaluated strictly as an isolated offline CLI render harness; never linked inside production FastAPI or client bundle.
